title: EUDPA-390 dev-only address lookup spike page (ins)
summary: A dev/local-only page at GET+POST /address-lookup-spike, registered only when the CDP-injected ENVIRONMENT is 'dev' or 'local' (no flag of our own). It searches trade-imports-ins-backend's GET /address-lookup by postcode or free text, shows per-hop timings (STS, Entra, gateway, backend total, page round trip) and a trace id, and maps a chosen result onto the address book's own fields, naming what the lookup cannot fill (county, ISO country code). Nothing is saved. The client follows the existing real/stub split so the page works with the backend down; the stub serves the same three addresses trade-imports-stub's simulator returns.
